from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class PaperRecord(BaseModel):
    """Represents one provided paper as extracted from a single document."""
    title: str = Field(description="The full title of this paper")
    referenced_titles: list[str] = Field(description="Titles of other provided papers that this paper cites in its reference list")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    papers: list[PaperRecord]
